title: Vite 8.3.1 → 8.3.4 bump in console-lab
summary: A dependency-only change: apps/console-lab pins Vite to 8.3.4 instead of 8.3.1, and pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated to match. The bump drags the Vite toolchain forward with it — rolldown 1.2.11 → 1.2.14 (and its per-platform native bindings), postcss 8.5.28 → 8.5.30, nanoid 3.3.19 → 3.3.20, source-map-js 1.2.1 → 1.2.2, and @oxc-project/types 0.151.0 → 0.154.0. No application source, config or build script changed; the console-lab build graph is the same, only the versions resolved into it differ.
